proof_0097.moves: Pure iota-reduction: endPos is defined by a match on the SearchStep constructors, so on the `matched p q` branch it computes to q and the goal closes by rfl. No mathematical step at all.

proof_0098.moves: s ∩ t is a subset of s, and being bounded below is inherited by subsets; so apply monotonicity of BddBelow to the inclusion inter_subset_left.

proof_0099.moves: Transport along the equality of propositions h : p₁ = p₂ (the ▸ / Eq.rec substitution), after which the two ∀-statements are literally the same and rfl closes it. The only content is the substitution.

proof_0100.moves: Definitional: the ForM instance for Option is literally Option.forM, so the two sides are the same function and rfl closes the goal. No mathematical step.

proof_0101.moves: This is not a proof at all: it is the automatically generated field projection of the class PreservesColimitOfIsReflexivePair, extracting its single axiom `out`. The only 'content' is that the statement is a field of that class.

proof_0102.moves: Negation on a quaternion algebra is defined componentwise, so the imI component of -a is by definition -(a.imI); rfl. Pure unfolding of the Neg instance.

proof_0103.moves: No proof: this is the structure projection extracting the additivity-in-the-first-argument axiom from the InnerProductSpace class. Additivity is assumed, not derived.

proof_0104.moves: A @[simps]-generated projection lemma: the graded-one instance on the constant family is defined with one := 1, so reading off its GOne.one field gives 1 by rfl. Pure unfolding of the instance definition.

proof_0105.moves: Apply closure under multiplication to -x ∈ s and y ∈ s to get (-x)*y ∈ s, then rewrite (-x)*y = -(x*y) via neg_mul to land on the stated goal.

proof_0106.moves: Not a proof: the parent-class projection extracting InfHomClass from LatticeHomClass, i.e. a lattice hom preserves infima because that is one of the fields of the class.

proof_0107.moves: Definitional: the sort-coercion of a set built from a predicate is by construction the subtype {x // x ∈ S}, so rfl. Pure unfolding of Set.Elem against Set.ofPred.

proof_0108.moves: intersperse is defined by matching on the list shape; the one-element pattern x :: [] falls into the base branch and returns [x] directly, so rfl. Purely computational.

proof_0109.moves: The bipointed type built from a two-pointed type has the same carrier by construction, so the coercion equality is rfl. Pure unfolding of toBipointed and the carrier projection.

proof_0110.moves: Commute the two factors so that a/b * (c/a) becomes (c/a) * (a/b), which is exactly the shape of the already-proved div_mul_div_cancel; then apply it. Two steps: mul_comm, then the cancellation lemma.

proof_0111.moves: Use the characterisation a :: l ⊆ m ↔ a ∈ m ∧ l ⊆ m in the backwards direction, feeding it the pair consisting of the membership hypothesis and the subset hypothesis.

proof_0112.moves: Case split on the Option: for none both sides are trivially true, for some a both sides reduce to (f a).all p. The whole content is the two-case analysis plus computation in each branch — no citable lemma carries it.

proof_0113.moves: Order-dual: ≤ on αᵒᵈ is the flip of ≤ on α while multiplication is unchanged, so right-cancellation on the dual is the base instance's right-cancellation composed with the flip (Contravariant.flip applied at the swapped multiplication). Then package it as the instance structure.

proof_0114.moves: A @[simps]-generated projection: multicospanShape is defined with snd j := j.1.2, so reading off its snd field gives that expression by rfl. Purely definitional unfolding.

proof_0115.moves: Unfold cancellability of 0 to the implication 0 + a ≤ 0 + b → a ≤ b, rewrite zero_add on both sides, and the remaining implication is literally the identity function.

proof_0116.moves: An additive unit acts through its underlying element, so the commutation of the two actions on αˣ-side is just the base VAddCommClass axiom applied to the coerced element; package that as the instance.

proof_0117.moves: The identity morphism of a frame object is the identity frame hom, so applying it to x returns x; simp unfolds the bundled identity and closes by reflexivity. The content is definitional unfolding, not any citable lemma — and the unfolding lemmas themselves are not in the list.

proof_0118.moves: Not a proof: the structure projection extracting the `property` field from an InducedWideCategory morphism, i.e. by construction such a morphism carries a proof that it satisfies P.

proof_0119.moves: Take x in Ioi a, i.e. a < x, and weaken strict inequality to ≤ to conclude x ∈ Ici a. One step: le_of_lt, after unfolding membership in the intervals.

proof_0120.moves: Case split on the outer Option: for none both sides are none, for some y both sides reduce to y.map f. The content is the two-case analysis plus computation, not any named lemma.
